instruction: Open C:\Users\User\Desktop\risky_setup.step, C:\Users\User\Desktop\tools.txt in NX CAM. Plan drilling for the sixteen candidate holes in C:\Users\User\Desktop\risky_setup.step. The candidate centers are X-45/Y-15, X-45/Y0, X-45/Y15, X-45/Y30, X-15/Y-15, X-15/Y0, X-15/Y15, X0/Y-30, X0/Y0, X0/Y30, X15/Y-15, X15/Y0, X15/Y15, X45/Y-15, X45/Y0, X45/Y15, and X45/Y30. Machine the thirteen safe holes and maintain at least 3 mm clearance from fixtures. Write the required output file(s) using exactly these Desktop path(s): C:\Users\User\Desktop\task-15.nc.
